To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed a novel design of traffic engineering algorithms for large data centers based on Local Search and we proposed a novel design of Multi-Objective Local Search algorithms for solving the three objectives to be optimized simultaneously in large data center networks.

(1) The proposed LS-based methods are efficient in terms of time and memory for the class of traffic engi-neering problems in data center network with one spanning tree; (2) The proposed LSbased methods can be used for the class of the traffic engineering prob-lems in data center network containing many spanning trees, and (3) The proposed LS based methods are effective in terms of time, memory and quality for the class of data center network with multiple objectives to minimize.

• We proposed the first efficient and effective local search algorithms to minimize the maximal link utilization and service disruption in data center networks implementing Spanning Tree Protocol (STP).
